messages:
Maria S.: @Auditor_Jess - quick q from your checklist: you asked for 'evidence of key usage and RBAC changes for last 90 days' — do you need raw KMS CloudTrail entries or the packaged CSV we drop into secure S3?

Auditor_Jess: Packaged CSV is fine, but we need per-request principal and key-id, plus rotation events and any authorization failures. Also a mapping to the control IDs we cited (SOC2/ISO).

Kevin L.: We can produce: kms-usage.csv (per-request rows), kms-rotation.json (rotation events), rbac-diff-<date>.json (terraform diffs + commit history). ETA today EOD. Any retention exceptions we should explicitly annotate?

Auditor_Jess: If any logs were archived outside the standard 90d window, include the reason and authorized SLA exception. Also flag any partial ingestion or backfills.

Dmitri: FYI we had a collector gap in eu-west-1: 2024-11-05T03:10–03:45 UTC (INC-2024-451). Backfill completed from backup; we'll attach backfill proof and the incident ticket.

Lina (infra): Packaging plan: create s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1723456789/{kms-usage.csv,kms-rotation.json,rbac-diff-2024-11-05.json,index.md,backfill.log}. index.md will map each file to SOC2/ISO control IDs and short justification.

Maria S.: PR for RBAC change: https://github.com/redwood/platform-admin/pull/2024 — shows service-account removal and approver. I'll attach the approve event and signed commit msg.

Kevin L.: Export commands for reviewer (example):
```
# splunk export
splunk search "index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:kms (ActionName=Decrypt OR ActionName=GenerateDataKey*)" -earliest "-90d" | outputcsv kms-usage.csv

# secure copy to evidence bucket
aws s3 cp kms-usage.csv s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1723456789/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

Auditor_Jess: Looks good. For the RBAC diff include terraform state diff + `git log` snippet that shows approver and timestamp. Also need the approval artifact (email or approver Slack confirmation).

Dmitri: We'll attach terraform plan output and `git log -1 --pretty=format:\"%h %an %ad %s\"` for the change commit. Approval thread link will be included.

Maria S.: Vulnerability context: the RBAC tighten was part of mitigation for CVE-2024-9999 in third-party lib X. Triage doc and mitigations (patch, config hardening, canary rollout) will be included.

Auditor_Jess: One last ask — please include 3 redacted KMS request rows (principal redacted) showing principal, keyid, action, outcome, and timestamp. We use them for sampling.

Kevin L.: Example sample we'll include (redacted):
`principal: user:REDACTED, keyid: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234, action:Decrypt, time:2024-10-28T12:03:22Z, result:Allowed` — will provide 3 signed rows.

Oncall-Bot: INC-2024-451 backfill completed by dmitri at 2024-11-06T09:12:07Z — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/audit-1723456789/backfill.log :white_check_mark:

Maria S.: I'll assemble the index.md with control crosswalk: mapping filenames to SOC2 CC6/ISO A.8.1/A.9, short rationale, and references to incident/pr/triage. Ping me if you need any extra format (CSV vs JSON). :thumbsup:

Auditor_Jess: Thanks all, that'll work — I'll confirm once I download and validate. If anything pops up I'll DM Maria or open a ticket here.

Kevin L.: 👍

Maria S.: done for now — uploading artifacts in ~30m and will post link here.
